params:
  ora: NULL
  interpretation: NULL
  title: "DEGinsight mechanism interpretation"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
ora <- params$ora
interp <- params$interpretation
```

## Top enriched pathways

```{r}
knitr::kable(head(ora, 20), caption = "Top 20 enriched pathways by adjusted p-value")
```

## Mechanistic hypotheses

```{r results='asis'}
if (inherits(interp, "deginsight_interpretation")) {
  for (h in interp$hypotheses) {
    cat("### ", h$name, " `(", h$evidence_grade, ")`\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(h$mechanism, "\n\n")
    cat("**Supporting pathways:** ", paste(unlist(h$supporting_pathways), collapse = "; "), "\n\n")
    cat("**Driver genes:** ", paste(unlist(h$driver_genes), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
    cat("**Follow-up experiment:** ", h$follow_up_experiment, "\n\n---\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("## Summary\n\n", interp$overall_summary, "\n\n")
} else if (inherits(interp, "deginsight_ensemble")) {
  cat("### Consensus pathways (multi-model)\n\n")
  sp <- interp$consensus$support
  knitr::kable(data.frame(pathway = names(sp), model_support = sp))
}
```

## Hallucination audit

```{r results='asis'}
if (inherits(interp, "deginsight_interpretation")) {
  cat(sprintf("Hallucination rate: **%.1f%%** (%d of %d cited terms)\n\n",
              100 * interp$validation$hallucination_rate,
              length(interp$validation$hallucinated),
              length(interp$validation$cited)))
  if (length(interp$validation$hallucinated)) {
    cat("Flagged terms: ", paste(interp$validation$hallucinated, collapse = ", "))
  }
}
```
